title: Why Sloths Risk Their Lives To Poop
description:
Three-toed sloths go down to the ground about once a week to urinate and defecate, digging a hole and covering it afterwards, always at the same spot. On the ground they are almost helpless and vulnerable to predators, which makes the trip dangerous. Their food can take a month or more to digest, and their shaggy fur hosts green algae that help camouflage them.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Sloth'.
